dates.description: Founding of SpaceX in El Segundo, California
Elon Musk met Robert Zubrin and donated to the Mars Society
Musk gave a plenary talk announcing Mars Oasis project
Musk started looking for staff for SpaceX
SpaceX protested NASA's sole-source contract to Kistler Aerospace to the GAO
SpaceX announced plans for human-rated commercial space program; decided to proceed with Falcon 9 development
SpaceX awarded $396 million NASA COTS contract; first Falcon 1 launch failure
First successful Falcon 1 launch on fourth attempt
NASA awarded SpaceX $1.6 billion Commercial Resupply Services contract
Falcon 1 retired after fifth total, second successful launch
Falcon 9 first launch with Dragon Spacecraft Qualification Unit
First operational Dragon spacecraft launched aboard COTS Demo Flight 1
NASA issued $75 million CCDev contract to SpaceX for launch escape system
NASA awarded SpaceX SAA for crew transportation system design
Dragon C2+ launch, first commercial spacecraft to deliver cargo to ISS
SpaceX active reusability test program began
SpaceX launched first commercial mission for private customer; Falcon 9 upgraded to v1.1
SpaceX won nine of 20 openly competed launch contracts worldwide
NASA awarded SpaceX the CCtCap contract
SpaceX raised $1 billion from Google and Fidelity; announced Starlink constellation
CRS-7 mission exploded two minutes into flight
Falcon 9 Flight 20 - first successful landing and recovery of a first stage
First successful landing on autonomous spaceport drone ship Of Course I Still Love You
Falcon 9 exploded during AMOS-6 static fire test
SpaceX returned to flight after AMOS-6 explosion
SpaceX launched returned Falcon 9 for SES-10, first re-launch of orbital rocket
SpaceX formed The Boring Company subsidiary; achieved 45% global market share for commercial launches
SpaceX raised $350 million at $21 billion valuation
Boring Company test tunnel completed
Boring Company test tunnel opened to public
Falcon Heavy inaugural flight launching Tesla Roadster
SpaceX had more than 100 launches on manifest worth $12 billion
SpaceX announced layoff of 10% of workforce to finance Starlink and Starship
SpaceX raised $1.33 billion across three funding rounds; Starship prototype construction started
SpaceX valuation risen to $33.3 billion; first large batch of 60 Starlink satellites launched
SpaceX valuation reached $36 billion; Dragon XL revealed
SpaceX valuation increased to $46 billion after $1.9 billion raise
Crew Dragon Demo-2 launched with NASA astronauts Doug Hurley and Bob Behnken
SpaceX raised $1.61 billion, valuation to ~$74 billion
SpaceX had raised more than $6 billion total by this year
SpaceX valuation grew to $100.3 billion
Starship HLS won NASA Artemis program contract
SpaceX entered agreements with Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure for Starlink
Funding round valued SpaceX at $127 billion
SpaceX unveiled drone ship A Shortfall of Gravitas
A Shortfall of Gravitas first landed CRS-23
Musk announced carbon dioxide removal program
SpaceX launched 61 rockets in total, most for a single vehicle type in a year; most launches focused on Starlink
ESA began discussions with SpaceX to substitute Russian launches
SpaceX announced acquisition of Pioneer Aerospace for $2.2 million
SpaceX moved headquarters from Hawthorne, California to Starbase, Texas
Polaris Dawn mission featured first private spacewalk
SpaceX agreed to invest $2 billion in xAI as part of $5 billion equity raise
SpaceX agreed to acquire Swarm Technologies for $524 million
FCC approved launch of up to 7,500 next-gen Starlink satellites; SpaceX announced Starshield
SpaceX agreed to purchase EchoStar spectrum rights for $17 billion
SpaceX activated Starlink service in Ukraine
Starlink expenses for Ukraine covered by US Department of Defense
Poland was largest contributor of Starlink terminals for Ukraine
Starlink eliminated service to non-whitelisted terminals in Ukraine
Starship's first orbital flight test ended in mid-air explosion
SpaceX executive said company ready to launch next Starship test since September
Starship second flight test launched
Starship launched for third time, reached planned suborbital trajectory
FAA granted launch license for Starship third flight test
SpaceX received launch license for Starship's fourth flight test
SpaceX received FAA approval for Starship's fifth flight test
Starship sixth flight test launched
Starship seventh flight test launched with Ship 33
FAA required mishap investigation of Starship seventh flight test failure
Starship launched from Texas, contact lost minutes into flight
SpaceX Starship rocket exploded during static fire test at Starbase
SpaceX launched twelfth flight test of Starship, first V3 vehicle flight
SpaceX announced acquisition of xAI
SpaceX announced Terafab project with Tesla and xAI
Anthropic signed $1.25 billion per month contract with xAI
Google and SpaceX agreed on computational rent agreement per securities filing
SpaceX received FAA approval for Starfall capsule
Elon Musk confirmed SpaceX would go public
Four banks selected to lead SpaceX IPO
SpaceX filed for IPO on Nasdaq under ticker SPCX
SpaceX priced IPO at $135 per share, valuation $1.77 trillion
SpaceX IPO raised $86 billion, began trading on Nasdaq, largest IPO in history
Nvidia announced Starmind satellite compute based on Vera Rubin system
Falcon 1 retired
Falcon 9 v1.0 successfully reached orbit on first attempt
COTS Demo Flight 2 launched, first commercial spacecraft to dock with ISS
Falcon 9 v1.1 upgrade
Falcon 9 Full Thrust upgrade; Starlink development began
Falcon 9 Block 5 upgrade
Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy launched 696 times total
Starlink prototype test-flight satellites launched on Paz mission
Initial test operation of Starlink constellation began late in year
First Starlink orders taken early in year
Starlink reached over 1 million subscribers worldwide
SpaceX introduced Starlink Mini antenna
Texas Commission on Environmental Quality cited SpaceX for environmental violations; Hawthorne facility ceased being HQ
SpaceX signed 20-year lease for KSC Launch Complex 39A
SpaceX launched first crewed mission to ISS from Launch Pad 39A
Pad 39A preparation for Starship launches began
39A Starship preparation accelerated
Pentagon approved SpaceX use of Cape Canaveral SLC-40
SLC-40 used since this year for Falcon 9 launches
Landing Zones 1 and 2 used from this year
Landing Zones 1 and 2 retired
Vandenberg SLC-4E leased from military
SLC-4W converted to Landing Zone 4
SpaceX won NASA COTS Phase 1 contract
SpaceX COTS Demo Flight 1, first private company to launch, orbit, recover a spacecraft
Dragon berthed with ISS during COTS Demo Flight 2
First CRS contracts signed, awarding $1.6 billion to SpaceX for 12 cargo missions
SpaceX CRS-1 launched
NASA extended Phase 1 contracts with additional resupply flights
Final Dragon 1 mission, SpaceX CRS-20, departed ISS
Second phase of CRS contracts awarded
NASA contracted SpaceX to develop Dragon XL spacecraft
First Commercial Crew Development contract awarded to SpaceX
Second CCDev contract awarded to SpaceX
NASA chose SpaceX and Boeing for Commercial Crew Program
SpaceX completed Pad Abort Test of Crew Dragon
SpaceX conducted full uncrewed Crew Dragon test flight
SpaceX conducted in-flight abort test
Crew Dragon Demo-2 launched with Bob Behnken and Doug Hurley
Crew-1 mission launched to ISS
Crew-2 launched to ISS
